rationale: Eric is building realtime AI avatar foundation models at North Model Labs, a domain that sits at the intersection of consumer AI and ML infrastructure — exactly where Christian's full-stack engineering and ML-infra focus at Together AI overlap. Christian's Python and TypeScript expertise, combined with his infrastructure mindset, could be valuable as Eric scales NML's price/performance positioning in the avatar space.
intro_message: Eric Sheen, meet Christian Cui — you're both working in the ML/AI infrastructure space and could explore how Together AI's infrastructure work might inform or support the real-time avatar models Eric is building at North Model Labs.
